sources.finding: Adjacency normalization explicitly leaves the precise homology expansion algorithm to be described; requires canonical orientation; warns that the same adjacencies can produce different derivative molecules. A documented specification gap does not establish absence of implementations.
Trial-use adjacency model includes linker and homology distinction. Public JSON fixture supplies two reference locations; normative start/end text and one figure caption disagree.
Simplification must preserve instructional purpose; measurement tasks restrict rescaling; some complex diagrams are not usefully tactile; proofreading remains a specified workflow.
Text-based Tactile Graphics Generation creates fabrication-ready reliefs, textures and braille and includes BLV user evaluation. Generation and printability alone therefore cannot be claimed novel.
OSS Rebuild already derives build definitions, rebuilds packages, publishes provenance, retrofits historical integrity and explores AI assistance.

Historical manifest search recovered source matches missed by inference; publication-time selection chose a wrong candidate in four of 29 ambiguous cases. Mechanism is already proposed by the issue author.
Explicitly proposes retaining and validating multiple historical source candidates, directly anticipating the narrowed software candidate.
A reproducible match is an integrity signal, not an assurance of absence of compromise; multiple factors and non-malicious rebuild failures matter.
Bitwise reproduction assumes the source, environment and build instructions.
Warns against using coordinate LiftOver to convert SNPs; broad variant portability was narrowed to adjacency normalization.

candidates.name: Sequence-preserving certificates for ambiguous structural-variant junctions
candidates.beneficiary: Genomics research laboratories, variant knowledgebases and sequencing software vendors reconciling structural-variant calls.
candidates.useful_output: A canonical junction representation plus an independently executable certificate of all equivalent coupled breakpoint shifts, or an explicit unsupported/ambiguous result. Later extension must preserve whole derivative-molecule topology.
candidates.restriction: Coordinates from distinct callers can differ because homologous sequence permits several breakpoint placements. A coordinate transform does not establish sequence equivalence, and two independent coordinate intervals can imply false combinations.
candidates.strongest_competitor: GA4GH VRS normalization and its implementations; established variant normalization itself is prior art.
candidates.explicit_residual_gap: S1 explicitly omits the precise adjacency homology-expansion algorithm, while S2 distinguishes homology from instrument uncertainty. Missing specification is verified; missing production capability remains unverified because implementation source access failed.
candidates.constructed_mechanism: Orient sequence contexts; enumerate or symbolically expand jointly shifted breakpoints; preserve the coupling relation; emit replayable sequence-equality witnesses and scoped rejection cases. Agents can reconcile specifications, construct adapters and generate adversarial fixtures; a deterministic checker validates outputs.
candidates.discovered_connection: Variant normalization can be treated as proof-producing compilation: representation rewriting should carry a checkable equivalence witness instead of collapsing uncertainty into a preferred coordinate.
candidates.enabling_change: Recent structural-variation object models expose enough semantics for explicit certificates, and capable coding agents lower construction cost. No claim that the core homology algorithm requires AGI.
candidates.minimal_construction: Implemented forward exact no-linker junction equivalence; parsed and canonically ordered a published VRS fixture; exhaustively tested bounded synthetic sequences.
candidates.decisive_falsifier: Next compare against current VRS, breakpoint-normalization and SV-merging implementations on public real junctions. Reject novelty if an existing tool already produces equivalent coupled certificates. Reject technical viability on any false merge, false split, reference truncation accepted as complete, or molecule-topology loss.
candidates.commercial_mechanism: Open certificate format/checker, paid validated integration and supported normalization service for research pipelines. Willingness to pay and addressable volume are unmeasured.
candidates.successor_inheritance: Checker, exact supported-domain contract, versioned source fixtures, adversarial corpus and explicit unsupported cases; additions must preserve all prior certificates.
candidates.status: Provisionally selected for further falsification; implementation opportunity, not established novel scientific invention.

candidates.name: Task-preserving tactile diagram compiler
candidates.beneficiary: Blind STEM students, accessible educational publishers and examination providers.
candidates.useful_output: Embossable multi-panel circuit or graph diagrams accompanied by a machine-checkable mapping from source relationships and allowed task operations to tactile panels.
candidates.restriction: A visually plausible or printable relief can change connectivity, omit a relation needed for a question, or distort a measurement. Descriptions can also reveal an assessment answer instead of enabling independent work.
candidates.strongest_competitor: Gao and colleagues' text-to-tactile generator, established tactile transcription practice, and semantic nonvisual data-structure systems.
candidates.explicit_residual_gap: S3 documents task-dependent simplification and measurement constraints; S4 supplies physical-generation capability but its retrieved scope does not establish preservation of source circuit connectivity or assessment operations. S11 already covers semantic relationships. This is a specific untested residual hypothesis, not verified competitor incapacity.
candidates.constructed_mechanism: Extract a typed circuit/graph model with uncertainty; compile source-task invariants into constraints; split panels to satisfy spacing; independently decode generated geometry and verify graph and measurement invariants; abstain when source semantics are uncertain.
candidates.discovered_connection: Accessible rendering can use compiler correctness and round-trip graph verification, making the original instructional task the invariant.
candidates.enabling_change: Multimodal parsing plus constraint-driven layout could connect existing tactile production to executable semantic checks.
candidates.minimal_construction: Not built in this round. First use 20 public schematic tasks with source netlists and compare generated panel connectivity and task answers before any user study.
candidates.decisive_falsifier: Reject if existing systems already preserve and certify these invariants, if semantic extraction cannot reliably abstain, or if blind readers cannot perform the tasks despite formal correctness. Physical/BLV evaluation is essential and was not available.
candidates.commercial_mechanism: Per-diagram validated production and publisher integrations, contingent on educator and reader acceptance.
candidates.successor_inheritance: Typed diagram semantics, task suite, geometry checker and reader-tested layout constraints.
candidates.status: Useful hypothesis; novelty and user-level performance unestablished.

candidates.name: Ambiguity-preserving recovery of legacy software provenance
candidates.beneficiary: Dependency security teams evaluating packages with stale repository metadata.
candidates.useful_output: A validated set of compatible historical source/build witnesses, with an explicit distinction between unique evidence and several plausible histories.
candidates.restriction: Single-candidate timestamp selection can choose the wrong historical source even when a matching commit exists; a successful rebuild alone does not establish a unique historical provenance.
candidates.explicit_residual_gap: S6 reports wrong candidate selection and S7 explicitly proposes preserving multiple candidates. This is a real engineering gap but the proposed mechanism is already anticipated.
candidates.constructed_mechanism: Search manifest blob history, retain multiple candidates, validate source-bearing files and rebuild, emit an ambiguity set rather than a falsely unique attribution.
candidates.discovered_connection: Provenance recovery is a set-valued inference problem, not simply finding a successful build recipe.
candidates.enabling_change: Agent-guided build investigation is already part of competitor direction; it does not earn a new capability claim.
candidates.minimal_construction: No construction: stopped after decisive prior-art collision.
candidates.decisive_falsifier: Already falsified as a discovery headline by S7; potentially valuable upstream work remains.
candidates.commercial_mechanism: Could improve existing supply-chain products; no defensible independent commercial wedge shown.
candidates.successor_inheritance: Ambiguous-source fixtures and constraints are reusable, but belong naturally in the existing tool ecosystem.
candidates.status: Rejected as novel; retain only as useful engineering backlog.

construction_results.public_source_fixture: Published VRS Adjacency JSON tested for location parsing and input-order invariance; no biological reference sequence was retrieved.
construction_results.decisive_counterexample: For A=CAGT, B=GAGC and junction (1,1), exactly (1,1), (2,2), (3,3) preserve CAGC. Independent intervals permit nine coordinate combinations; six produce a different molecule.
construction_results.interpretation: Shows the coupled-uncertainty requirement and feasibility of a narrow exact kernel. Does not establish real-world superiority, novelty, clinical validity, whole-molecule correctness or VRS compliance.

decision: Advance U2-1 only to competitor-code inspection and a public real-data comparison. Do not claim three established new opportunities: the evidence supports one narrow provisional lead, one accessibility hypothesis and one explicit prior-art rejection.
